Blacksmithing
Making and enhancing metal equipment. Blacksmiths don't create armor directly, but they can buttress metal armor's effectiveness. They also create metal parts for many other skills.
Skill Type:
Trade Skill
Max Level:
90
Requirements:
Armor Patching
25
Skill Trainers:
Tadion
,
Kodan
,
Falkrin Overstrike
,
Solgribue
,
Dunahain Broadarm
“
Hmm... no, I don't think I can. I just don't think you'd understand enough of what I said! No offense meant, friend. Why don't you practice bangin' out dents in armor first?
— "Tadion"
Blacksmithing Overview
Blacksmithing
is a crafting skill often confused with
Armorsmithing
. Blacksmiths do not create armor, but can improve the protective capabilities of armor. Many Blacksmiths create items that can be used in
Carpentry
,
Toolcrafting
,
Cheesemaking
, and other skills.
In-Game Description
Making and enhancing metal equipment. Blacksmiths don't create armor directly, but they can buttress metal armor's effectiveness. They also create metal parts for many other skills.
Training Blacksmithing
Tadion
, an Elf living in
Serbule
, will teach Blacksmithing to anyone who has reached Level 25
Armor Patching
.
Kalaba
, a Rakshasa living at the
Eltibule Keep
, is knowledgeable in crafting Deer Shoes using Blacksmithing.
Bahdba
, a Fae residing near the stone statue in the southeast of Serbule, is knowledgeable in crafting throwing knives.
Borghild
is rumored to contain many secrets. Blacksmithing recipes for metal-based statues may be discovered in this dangerous dungeon.
Falkrin Overstrike
, a resident of
Amulna
, the last remaining town in the
Ilmari
Desert, can raise the Skill Cap of
Blacksmithing
from level 50 to 60, and level 60 to 70.
Kodan
, a Lycanthrope living in
Sun Vale
's
Animal Town
, can also raise the Skill Cap to 60 and 70.
Solgribue
will aid developing blacksmith in reaching levels 70 to 80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Dunahain Broadarm
deep beneath
Povus
.
Connected Skills
Sub-Skills:
Armorsmithing
Bladesmithing
50 blacksmithing required to obtain
Secondary Skills:
Armor Patching
- Blacksmithing requires Level 25 Armor Patching
Toolcrafting
- Toolcrafting requires Level 20 Blacksmithing or Carpentry.
Dye Making
- Blacksmithing is used to apply dyes to Metal Armor.
Related Skills:
Surveying
,
Mining
- Blacksmiths obtain many of the metals they use through Surveying.
Carpentry
- Carpentry uses some of the items Blacksmiths create.
Cheesemaking
- Some Blacksmiths create items used in Cheesemaking.

Blacksmithing Mechanics
Forge Locations
Serbule
A forge can be found in the enclosed section inside
Serbule Keep
. It is near the A-aisle player merchant stalls, next to a tanning rack, and belongs to
Tadion
.
Eltibule
There is a forge in
Eltibule Keep
, to the right as you come through the front gates. It is often used by
Kalaba
.
Red Wing Casino
The boiler near
Dorimir Fangblade
(near the Employee Entrance) can be used as a forge.
Rahu
A forge can be found in the center of the friendly section of the
City of Rahu
, up the stairs, next to the garden, tanning rack, and cotton gin.
Kur Mountains
A forge can be found at
Ukorga
's Northwestern Outpost. It is in the building with the
Council Storage
machine, right next to
Janet Lews
.
Ilmari
A forge can be found inside the northern gate of
Amulna
, next to the Work Order board.
New Prestonbule Cave
Toward the back of the cave, past the second portcullis, the orc
Torgan
works next to a forge. You can use the forge even if you don't know enough
Orcish
(Level 25 or higher) to communicate with him.
Fae Realm
There is a forge near
Solgribue
, the friendly troll in the main Fae settlement.
Povus
There are two forges in Povus. One is behind the building with
Tremmond Blackhammer
and is consecrated to Umrad, meaning besides ordinary
Blacksmithing
,
Toolcrafting
,
Jewelry Crafting
, and
Armorsmithing
, it can also be used to make Dwarven metal armor, a specialized type of metal armor. Another special forge is consecrated to Tast in the Orc encampment and is needed when crafting Orcish metal armor.
Wolf Cave
There is a forge consecrated to
Norala the Huntress
down one of the early side tunnels not far from the entrance. It is needed to forge metal armor for lycans. Like the other consecrated forges, it can also be used to make other items that require a regular forge.
Notable zones without forges:
Anagoge Island
,
Serbule Hills
,
Sun Vale
, and
Gazluk
, as well as the dungeons and caves not named here.

lists: Tadion, an Elf living inSerbule, will teach Blacksmithing to anyone who has reached Level 25Armor Patching.
Kalaba, a Rakshasa living at theEltibule Keep, is knowledgeable in crafting Deer Shoes using Blacksmithing.
Bahdba, a Fae residing near the stone statue in the southeast of Serbule, is knowledgeable in crafting throwing knives.
Borghildis rumored to contain many secrets. Blacksmithing recipes for metal-based statues may be discovered in this dangerous dungeon.
Falkrin Overstrike, a resident ofAmulna, the last remaining town in theIlmariDesert, can raise the Skill Cap ofBlacksmithingfrom level 50 to 60, and level 60 to 70.
Kodan, a Lycanthrope living inSun Vale'sAnimal Town, can also raise the Skill Cap to 60 and 70.
Solgribuewill aid developing blacksmith in reaching levels 70 to 80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked byDunahain Broadarmdeep beneathPovus.
Armor Patching- Blacksmithing requires Level 25 Armor Patching
Toolcrafting- Toolcrafting requires Level 20 Blacksmithing or Carpentry.
Dye Making- Blacksmithing is used to apply dyes to Metal Armor.
Surveying,Mining- Blacksmiths obtain many of the metals they use through Surveying.
Carpentry- Carpentry uses some of the items Blacksmiths create.
Cheesemaking- Some Blacksmiths create items used in Cheesemaking.
